stage.name: Research Base Hangar
stage.description:
The prototype power armors stored in Test Site 359's hanger have suddenly reactivated during the cleanup work. The Rhodes Island operators present must quickly intervene and bring this incident to a close.
<Special Conditions>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<R-Series Power Armor>Absorbs nearby experimental products to recover SP. Activates when SP is full.

rhine_defense_senior_member.name: Rhine Defense Senior Member
rhine_defense_senior_member.flavourText: Security personnel of Rhine Lab. With their company-provided anti-riot gear and advanced training, they are much more qualified for escort duties.
abilities: Blocks 1 instance of Physical or Arts damage

dor_replica.name: Dor-β Replica
dor_replica.flavourText: A product of Dorothy's repeated experiments. Even though it fell far below expectations, she remains ever hopeful.
abilities: When touching an inactive <R-Series Power Armor>, the Power Armor recovers some SP

dor_1_failure.name: Dor-1 Failure
dor_1_failure.flavourText: A product of Dorothy's failed experiments. An irregularly-shaped silver object emanating a soft glow, like a slumbering Dreamland.
abilities: When touching an inactive <R-Series Power Armor>, the Power Armor recovers some SP

dor_failure.name: Dor-α Failure
dor_failure.flavourText: A product of Dorothy's failed experiments. An irregularly-shaped silver object emanating a soft glow, its unusual appearance instinctively scares people away from it.
abilities: When touching an inactive <R-Series Power Armor>, the Power Armor recovers some SP

rhine_defense_member.name: Rhine Defense Member
rhine_defense_member.flavourText: Guard personnel of Rhine Lab. With their company-provided anti-riot gear and training, they are qualified for escort duties.
abilities: Blocks 1 instance of Physical or Arts damage

rhine_engineering_senior_member.name: Rhine Engineering Senior Member
rhine_engineering_senior_member.flavourText: A senior engineer of Rhine Lab. Energy managed to convince Columbia's officials to provide the company more funding, so Engineering took the chance to design and produce even more sophisticated equipment.
abilities: Recovers the HP of inactive <R-Series Power Armors>

dor_2_replica.name: Dor-2 Replica
dor_2_replica.flavourText: A product of Dorothy's repeated experiments. She was fascinated by its beauty when it was first created.
abilities: When touching an inactive <R-Series Power Armor>, the Power Armor recovers some SP

rhine_engineering_member.name: Rhine Engineering Member
rhine_engineering_member.flavourText: An engineer of Rhine Lab. Responsible for both providing equipment and giving their professional opinion on its production, they also maintain a close relationship with the Energy Section.
abilities: Recovers the HP of inactive <R-Series Power Armors>

experimental_power_armor.name: Experimental Power Armor
experimental_power_armor.flavourText: An unpiloted Power Armor. It is able to function without a pilot, but nevertheless maintains high agility.

dor_bionic.name: Dor-γ Bionic
dor_bionic.flavourText: A product of Dorothy's private experiments. Dreams must ultimately feed back into reality, and she hopes to be a warm and safe harbor.
abilities: When not blocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced
When touching an inactive <R-Series Power Armor>, the Power Armor recovers a lot of SP

test_power_armor.name: Test Power Armor
test_power_armor.flavourText: An unpiloted Power Armor. It seems to have a mind of its own, and even experienced engineers struggle to tell if it's being piloted.

r_11a_assault_power_armor.name: R-11a Assault Power Armor
r_11a_assault_power_armor.flavourText: A model equipped with long-ranged weapons, massively increasing its offensive capabilities. It's difficult to imagine what sort of changes might come about if this tech could be mass-produced.

r_31a_heavy_power_armor.name: R-31a Heavy Power Armor
r_31a_heavy_power_armor.flavourText: A model that appeared around half a year ago among some mercenary groups, its performance is on par with mass-produced military models from five years ago. Technology is unregulated, so Columbians continue to seek greater efficiency within the bounds of the law.
abilities: [Overload] Continuously deals Physical damage to the target proportional to the unit's ATK, andStuns the target

dor_3_bionic.name: Dor-3 Bionic
dor_3_bionic.flavourText: A product of Dorothy's private experiments. To her, it is not a mere creation, it is her family, her dream.
abilities: When not blocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced
When touching an inactive <R-Series Power Armor>, the Power Armor recovers a lot of SP

r_11_assault_power_armor.name: R-11 Assault Power Armor
r_11_assault_power_armor.flavourText: A model equipped with long-ranged weapons, massively increasing its offensive capabilities. While these experimental weapons are still in the prototype phase, its energy and firepower cannot be overlooked.

r_31_heavy_power_armor.name: R-31 Heavy Power Armor
r_31_heavy_power_armor.flavourText: A model that appeared around half a year ago among some mercenary groups, its performance is on par with mass-produced military models from five years ago. Rhine Lab's Energy Section cooperates with many parties, and continues to look for ever more opportunities.
abilities: [Overload] Continuously deals Physical damage to the target proportional to the unit's ATK, andStuns the target
